_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); athletic footwear and apparel signals

pit_profile.why: NIKE: 'NIKE is the largest seller of athletic footwear and apparel in the world', and 'Virtually all of our products are manufactured by independent contractors' (its own FY2017 10-K); the industry 'is highly competitive on a worldwide basis', 'including adidas, ASICS, Li Ning, lululemon athletica, Puma, Under Armour and V.F. Corporation, among others', and 'the relative popularity of various sports and fitness activities and changing design trends affect the demand for our products': a demand and fashion risk, not an obsolescence one

theme_watch.reason: Live: NIKE's own FY2017 10-K says 'In addition, the competitive nature of retail including shifts in the ways in which consumers are shopping, and the rising trend of digital commerce, constitutes a risk factor implicating our DTC and wholesale operations.' At the same time it sells online itself: 'digital commerce sales through NIKE-owned websites and mobile applications, which are not included in comparable store sales, were $2.2 billion for fiscal 2017'. The stock trades at 21.3x FY18E — near its own median. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ECOMMERCE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing the shift away from physical retail into NIKE's own sales specifically.

classification.quality_note: NIKE: 'NIKE is the largest seller of athletic footwear and apparel in the world', and 'Virtually all of our products are manufactured by independent contractors' (its own FY2017 10-K); the industry 'is highly competitive on a worldwide basis', 'including adidas, ASICS, Li Ning, lululemon athletica, Puma, Under Armour and V.F. Corporation, among others', and 'the relative popularity of various sports and fitness activities and changing design trends affect the demand for our products': a demand and fashion risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 0.66x; +33% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.55; conservative 2yr +10%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY08-FY17, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +9.0%/yr (Q4 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +12.6%/yr (FY08-FY17 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +20.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY17); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NKE (retrospective, 2017-09-01) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.66x (26.9% downside to Bear $39 / +40.6% upside to Bull $75) | Adj composite 2.05 vs market 2.60: gap -0.55 [OVERVALUED] | +33% above the EPP floor $40 (16x FY18E $2.51) | Conservative 2-yr case: +10.4% total (+5.2%/yr) | At 21.3x FY18E the 15% hurdle price $71 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; futures orders -2.0% in Q4 FY17, forward revenues +7% (Q4 FY17 revenue ex-currency); e-commerce is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
